notes: PHF AI Sandbox v1 (DeepSeek, admin-only, thu nghiem). Module hoan toan moi, khong dung Checklist/Classroom/Training Hub/KNL/Auth engine. Backend: lib/ai-sandbox.js (validate messages, system prompt server-side, goi DeepSeek qua process.env.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, rate-limit + chong double-submit rieng trong module, timeout 30s, khong retry) dung chung cho api/ai/chat.js (Vercel) va nhanh /api/ai/chat trong server.js (Render/local) - ca hai deu bat buoc requireSession(req,['admin']) truoc moi validate/goi DeepSeek. Model server-side constant deepseek-v4-pro (deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner da retire 2026-07-24), client khong duoc chon model/max_tokens/system prompt. Khong Supabase read/write, khong tool/action, khong luu lich su hoi thoai (chi state FE trong phien, F5 mat - chap nhan o v1). Frontend: assets/js/ai/phf-ai-sandbox.js + assets/css/phf-ai-sandbox.css, route rieng /admin/ai-sandbox (chi role admin, khong co /ql hay /hv tuong ung, khong them vao menu Manager/Learner). Route wiring: ROUTE_REGISTRY + PHF_ROUTE_MAP.admin trong assets/js/phf-url-router.js, va shell rieng 'ai-sandbox' (shellFor/sync/PHFAppShell) trong index.html mirror dung pattern KNL - khong sua route/shell cua module khac.
